Restore Center (real end-to-end restore): SafetyCenter.execute now captures the real resultingItemURL from FileManager.trashItem and emits a RestoreManifestRecord (Sources/SafetyCore/RestoreManifest.swift) per successful Trash move — never the permanent removeItem fallback. Sink auto-detected (sink as? RestoreManifestSink; Persistence.Store conforms), so Cleanup/Developer Center/Applications uninstall/Recovery Plan/Duplicates/Leftovers/Privacy capture manifests with zero call-site changes and no second execution path. DB schema v7 restore_manifest is the one table with real unredacted paths (original + Trash location), one row per Trashed operation item (a directory root is one row); safety_log stays redacted, correlating only by operation_id. Retention: rows >90 days pruned, non-available rows >30 days, on every write. RestoreService actor (Sources/CoreTendApp/) does every move: per-item re-read manifest -> recompute live availability (inode + volume UUID + directory-ness vs Trash item; parent + occupancy vs destination) -> RestoreValidator (destination pinned to recorded original, never arbitrary/protected-root; collision REFUSED, never overwritten; source inside a .Trash/.Trashes dir) -> FileManager.moveItem back -> mark restored + redacted .executed SafetyAuditEvent. Per-item, never atomic; one coarse .restore ActivityRecord per run with real counts. RestoreReversibility.of(_:) is the sole producer of .restorableByCoreTend and only for a live .available item; AdvisorService and RecoveryPlanEligibility unchanged. UI: RestoreCenterView (System sidebar, after My Activity). clearRestoreManifests ('Forget Restore History') removes records only, never empties the Trash; excluded from DiagnosticReport/Timeline/audit exports. 41 new tests. HUMAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED: real external-volume restore (model exercised with synthetic volume identity); interactive VoiceOver/keyboard on the new screen. See Documentation/RESTORE.md, SAFETY_MODEL.md -> 'Restore Center', PERSISTENCE.md, FEATURE_MATRIX.md.

macOS Integrations Core (App Intents / local notifications / scheduled read-only scans): all read-only, all reusing existing domain services. App Intents (Sources/CoreTendApp/CoreTendIntents.swift + pure CoreTendIntentText.swift): 7 intents + 6 App Shortcuts (CoreTendAppShortcuts.swift). No destructive intent - enforced by dependency structure (no FileRules import; no SafetyCenter/CleanupExecution/RecoveryPlanService/RestoreService reference; MacIntegrationsSafetyTests greps comment-stripped source). Image-metadata intent reuses ImageMetadataInspector, path never stored. Local notifications (NotificationService.swift, UNUserNotificationCenter only): 3 toggleable categories (lowDiskSpace/scanResults/storageGrowth, coalesced), no 'a scan ran' category, in-context permission only, NotificationPolicy rate limiting, aggregates-only bodies (no path/name/location/GPS/profile), userInfo = ModuleID rawValue only. AppRouter.swift: one shared deep-link front door reusing .mcNavigate, cold-launch buffered + drained in MainWindow.onAppear. Scheduled scans: ScheduledScanService actor + NSBackgroundActivityScheduler behind BackgroundScheduling protocol; Off/Daily/Weekly; same ScanEngine + UserCleanupRules + shared CleanupTimeline.samples as interactive Cleanup; Timeline snapshot trigger='scheduled' only on ScanEvent.finished; cancelled/incomplete writes nothing; reuses single AppEnvironment.shared.store; inProgress guard; cancellable; no FDA assumed/prompted. Settings: Scheduled Scans picker + Notifications section (3 @AppStorage keys in settings-matrix.json). 73 new EN/FR keys, parity verified. 46 new tests. HUMAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED: Shortcuts-app discovery + FR phrases (App Intents metadata bundle in packaged .app); real notification permission + system delivery; live cold-launch deep links; scheduled execution over real wall-clock; VoiceOver/keyboard on new Settings controls. WidgetKit + Finder Extension NOT built (analysis only). See Documentation/MACOS_INTEGRATIONS.md.

WidgetShared SwiftPM target (Sources/WidgetShared/): WidgetSnapshot (Codable/Sendable, schemaVersion=1, staleAfter=7d), WidgetSnapshotStore (App Group group.com.ahmetbsbnr.coretend, widget-snapshot.v1.json, atomic write, typed ReadResult.unavailable(reason:) for appGroupUnavailable/fileMissing/unreadable/malformed/unsupportedFutureVersion, .secondsSince1970 dates), WidgetSnapshotDisplay (WidgetDisplayModel; trend stated in words not colour/arrow; placeholder never '0'), Resources/{Base,fr}.lproj/Localizable.strings (EN/FR exact parity, UTF-16).
